title: Sleep under net wey dem treat
body: Make you sleep under insecticide-treated net every night to stop malaria, especially pikin and pregnant woman.

title: Antenatal visit
body: Go clinic for antenatal check-up at least four times when you dey pregnant so mama and pikin go dey healthy.

title: Chop well without spending plenty money
body: Mix beans, vegetable and grain make you get balanced food without spending plenty money.

title: Wash your hand
body: Wash your hand with soap and clean water before you chop and after you use toilet.

title: Water wey safe to drink
body: Boil or treat water before you drink am if you no sure say e clean.

title: First aid for burn
body: Put small burn under running water for around twenty minutes. No put oil or toothpaste.

title: Vaccine for pikin
body: Carry your pikin go take all the routine vaccine on time to protect am from serious sickness.

title: Fever for pikin
body: If pikin get fever with convulsion, fast breathing, or e no fit drink, carry am go clinic sharp sharp.

title: Breastfeeding basics
body: Start to breastfeed within the first hour after birth and give only breast milk for six months.

title: Malaria when you dey pregnant
body: Pregnant woman suppose sleep under treated net and take the medicine wey clinic give for malaria prevention.
